title: Command Palette (Ctrl+K) Power Search & Quick Actions

intro.title: Command Palette & Quick Actions
intro.subtitle: Navigate any module in milliseconds with shortcut Ctrl+K

narration.text: Welcome to Part 3. In high-speed pharmacies, cashiers shouldn't waste time clicking nested menus. Press Control plus K to launch the MediFlow Command Palette from anywhere.
narration.caption: Press Ctrl+K from anywhere in MediFlow to open the global Command Palette.

narration.text: The palette opens instantly over your workspace. Type any keyword like 'batches' or 'stock' to filter through all pharmacy modules in milliseconds.
narration.caption: Search any module or action in milliseconds—type 'batches' to see stock tools.

narration.text: Use the up and down arrow keys to navigate, then press Enter to jump straight to that screen without lifting your hands from the keyboard.
narration.caption: Use Arrow keys to select and press Enter to jump straight to the module.

narration.text: Beyond navigation, the command palette can trigger quick actions like opening the shortcuts cheat sheet or launching the AI Assistant.
narration.caption: Execute quick actions: launch the shortcuts cheat sheet or trigger AI Assistant.

narration.text: Mastering Ctrl plus K saves pharmacists hundreds of clicks every single day. In Part 4, we will cover MediFlow's 7 user roles and permission safeguards.
narration.caption: Save hundreds of clicks daily! Watch Part 4 to explore the 7 pharmacy roles.

outro.takeaway: Speed Rule: Experienced pharmacy cashiers use Ctrl+K to navigate 3x faster than mouse clicks.
